claims.claim_text: The indexed David Atherton is probably the 21-year-old American soldier documented with OSS Operational Group Emily in France in 1944.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Her father David Atherton, then 21, was parachuted into France on July 9, 1944 as part of Operational Group (OG) ‘Emily’.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two 2025 reports about a family photograph donation identify David Atherton as an American wartime parachutist in OSS Operational Group Emily.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable: exact name, direct OSS context, American military status, age, 1944 chronology, and a named operational group align with the indexed T-5. The reports do not reproduce his indexed grade, private identifier, or Box 24 linkage and share a family-source origin.
claims.temporal_assessment: The evidence establishes a 1944 OSS assignment but identifies neither an immediate pre-OSS affiliation nor a last civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Published only as a qualified identity and wartime-assignment lead. The two reports disagree on the parachute date, June 9 versus July 9, so no exact date is asserted in the claim beyond 1944.
